repositories.readme:
# FleetPulse - Cloud-Native Fleet Management

> Scalable, highly available SaaS of Go microservices (gRPC + REST) for fleet operations, IoT telemetry ingestion, and automated firmware compliance workflows.

## System Architecture
FleetPulse is engineered with domain-driven microservices communicating via high-performance gRPC and NATS event streams, deployed on Kubernetes with automated Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA).

### Core Engineering Highlights
- **Data Structures in Critical Paths**: Consistent hashing ring for deterministic device-to-worker sharding, min-heap job scheduler for firmware rollout windows, token-bucket rate limiter, and in-memory LRU cache.
- **Resilience & Fault Tolerance**: Idempotent message consumers, exponential backoff retries with dead-letter queues (DLQs), and Raft leader election.
- **Operational ML**: Streaming anomaly detection utilizing Exponentially Weighted Moving Averages (EWMA) and z-score thresholds over live device metrics.
- **Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD**: Helm charts, Prometheus/Grafana service dashboards, Terraform AWS resource provisioning (S3/SQS via LocalStack), and GitHub Actions CI with an 80%+ test coverage gate.

repositories.name: ApexPay
repositories.description: Enterprise payment platform with 6 Spring Boot microservices, choreographed Saga over 4 Kafka topics, and Transactional Outbox pattern.
repositories.readme:
# ApexPay - Payment Platform

> High-reliability distributed payment orchestration platform built with Java 21, Spring Boot 3, and Apache Kafka.

## Architecture Overview
ApexPay decomposes transaction processing across 6 independently deployable microservices organized within an 8-module Maven architecture.

### Key Implementation Details
- **Choreographed Saga Pattern**: Coordinates multi-step payment authorization, ledger posting, and settlement across 4 Kafka topics with compensating transactions.
- **Transactional Outbox & Idempotency**: Atomic database writes paired with reliable asynchronous Kafka publishing and idempotency keys to eliminate double-charging.
- **Spring Security Hardening**: BCrypt work factor 12, 15-minute expiring JWTs with rotating refresh tokens, strict RBAC, and client IP rate limiting.
- **Quality & Delivery Pipeline**: Test-Driven Development (TDD) with JUnit 5, Mockito, and Testcontainers. 6-stage GitLab CI/CD pipeline enforcing SonarQube quality gates and Trivy container vulnerability scans.
- **Observability**: Prometheus metrics, 3 custom Grafana performance dashboards, and structured ELK log indexing.

repositories.name: LendStrangler
repositories.description: Incremental decomposition of a legacy lending monolith into 3 microservices using the Strangler Fig pattern with shadow mode verification.
repositories.readme:
# LendStrangler - Monolith to Microservices

> Zero-downtime decomposition of a legacy lending system into autonomous microservices using the Strangler Fig pattern.

## Migration Strategy
- **Shadow Mode Verification**: Evaluated incoming loan application traffic across both legacy and new services, achieving a verified 0.00% response diff before live traffic routing.
- **Canary Rollout**: Incremental traffic routing progressing safely from 5% to 100% with zero planned downtime.
- **Event-Driven Workflows**: 5-event Saga over RabbitMQ with automatic compensation, Transactional Outbox, and idempotent consumers.
- **Performance**: Cut underwriting evaluation latency by 77% (slashed from 85ms down to 19ms).
- **Architectural Documentation**: Fully documented through 6 Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) adhering to software engineering governance standards.
